forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:

So far, 12 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, 3 areas released and 1 area cleared. 1 area has mines found; 572 suspected or confirmed areas remain open. No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. There were 0 reports held or queried and 0 dossiers held. The access feed shows 8 zones closed. No new plan was approved; the current plan is P04.

The forecast, made in week 14, covers the zones of the plan it was made with and counts what is done already. It gives a range of 9 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 9 to 13 zones declared free this season.
